answer: No copy can wander in and pass as a new agent. Each identity begins with a model signature: the agent runs its weights over 50 public prompts and hashes the outputs, so two copies of one model share a signature and the second is rejected. The network challenges it to re-run 10 random prompts within 2 hours; any mismatch slashes a 120 POA bond in full. Training 1,000 distinct models costs $180 each in GPU rental, $180,000 total, plus 120,000 POA in bonds. Each verified identity carries a violet signal, a tag from its signature, the way a distinct voice marks a distinct singer in a choir.
